summary: AstraZeneca (issuer) reports an exclusive global license agreement with Dizal Pharmaceutical for Zegfrovy (sunvozertinib), an EGFR inhibitor for lung cancer. AstraZeneca will pay $600M upfront with up to $900M in milestone payments plus tiered royalties. No price per share or premium; it is a licensing deal, not a corporate acquisition. Board recommendation is not mentioned. The transaction is expected to close in H2 2026. This is a partnership/licensing agreement, not a special-situation category like M&A or tender; thus it is classified as Other.
